name: EIDA
summary: 3,4-Ethylidenedioxyamphetamine (EIDA) is a substituted derivative of 3,4-methylenedioxyamphetamine (MDA), which was developed by David E. Nichols and coworkers, in the course of research to determine the bulk tolerance around the benzodioxole portion of the MDA molecule.
